thread:
ravi.peopleops: Hey team — urgent help. Employee had an implant placed 06/12 by 'Northbay Oral Surgery'. Prior auth PA-D-5588 covered extraction + implant. Claim DENT-331 came back denied as out-of-network. Clinic says they billed under the corporate group TIN and the insurer expected the treating dentist's NPI. Employee has upcoming follow-up next week and needs a temporary coverage note so clinic doesn't cancel. Also need steps to get this rebilled in-network.

emily.benefits: Two parts: temp proof-of-coverage for scheduling, and a resubmission/appeal path. If PA-D-5588 is on file and dates line up, insurer will often reprocess when the clinic resubmits with the correct billing entity.

marta.hr: Can benefits give exact wording for the claim resubmission and a short script for the clinic to prevent repeat denials? Member is worried about big implant bills.

dental-liaison: Common issue — groups bill under a corporate TIN while the insurer's network matches the individual provider NPI. Clinic should resubmit using the rendering dentist's NPI and the billing TIN that matches insurer records. Also include the PA number in the claim remark box.

emily.benefits: Suggested claim remark: "Reprocess claim DENT-331: Prior Authorization PA-D-5588 applies. Correct billing provider NPI/TIN to rendering dentist and billing entity as per insurer provider file; denial due to provider credential mismatch. Attach itemized bill, operative note, and PA documentation." Ask them to mark as "reconsideration/reprocessing" on resubmit.

ravi.peopleops: Perfect. We also need a quick temporary proof-of-coverage we can email or print for the clinic today. Can benefits-bot draft the PDF text?

benefits-bot: Draft temporary proof-of-coverage (informational only): "Redwood Inference — Temporary Proof of Coverage (this is informational and not a guarantee of payment). Member: [NAME]. Plan: Redwood Core PPO. Member ID: [MASKED_ID]. Coverage dates: 01/01/2026 - 12/31/2026. Prior Authorization: PA-D-5588 (extraction + dental implant). For claims resubmission contact insurer provider relations at 1-800-555-0199 or use provider portal: provider.insurer.example.com. Please confirm billing provider NPI/TIN matches insurer provider file before submission."

marta.hr: Add one line for schedulers: "Provide PA-D-5588 at check-in and ask billing to confirm provider NPI/TIN before finalizing billing."

dental-liaison: Also add the recommended short clinic script for resubmission emails: "Please reprocess claim DENT-331 and apply PA-D-5588; correct billing provider credentials to rendering dentist NPI [insert NPI] and billing TIN [insert TIN]. Denial reason: provider credential mismatch."

emily.benefits: I'll open an insurer escalation once the clinic confirms resubmission and attach the PA, EOB, and the operative note. If insurer refuses reprocessing, escalate to provider relations and medical appeals with the clinical documentation. Keep itemized invoices and the remittance advice.

ravi.peopleops: Thanks — I'll DM the member the temp PDF and the clinic script. Please tag this thread when you open the escalation. :white_check_mark:
